description: Create a donation campaign. campaignId is the PUBLIC slug used in data-nanocart-donate="..." and <nanocart-donate-stats campaign="..."> — lowercase letters/numbers/dashes, immutable after creation. Embed snippet: <button data-nanocart-donate="SLUG">Donate</button> (plus the store's widget script tag). Plans allow 1 campaign (Free/Standard) or 10 (Pro/Expert).

allow_recurring.description: Monthly giving — requires Stripe AND the 4 subscription webhook events on the merchant Stripe endpoint

stats.description: Which fields the PUBLIC stats widget may show — disabled fields never leave the API

status.description: paused hides the donate button and stats widget immediately

success_url.description: Thank-you page ("/thank-you" or full URL); empty = built-in thank-you popup

suggested_monthly_cents.description: Suggested amounts in integer CENTS (e.g. [500, 1000, 2500] = $5/$10/$25), max 8

suggested_one_time_cents.description: Suggested amounts in integer CENTS (e.g. [500, 1000, 2500] = $5/$10/$25), max 8

name: create_donation_campaign
